# Daybook action list

What is left to do, checked against the app as it stands. **Rewritten on 31 October 2026 (v365)**, when Mark said the list had never been accurate: every action was checked against the code, seven that were done but never ticked off moved to Done, and the numbering started again. Older notes in `CLAUDE.md` that say "action 8" or "action 17" mean the numbering before that day.

**How it is kept:** the open actions below are generated by `tools/roadmap_page_gen.py` from the lists in that file, together with the live page (https://claude.ai/artifact/PCi6gEEHuHR9idt9fPbwks, private to Mark). Each action carries a prompt Mark can paste into the chat to start on it. To change the list: edit the lists in the script, run `python3 tools/roadmap_page_gen.py` from the repository root, commit, and republish `roadmap.html` to the live page in the same turn. Finishing an action means taking it out of the script's lists and adding a line to Done below.

Decisions already made, so they are not reopened:
- Cost: cheap and pay-as-you-go, never a fixed monthly bill while usage is small (see the cost rule in `CLAUDE.md`).
- The name is **My Medical Daybook** in full, Daybook inside the app (v89).
- **One app, with condition packs**, not an app per condition (Mark, 5 October 2026): Apple refuses the same app under several names, people have more than one condition, and a condition in an app's name on a Home Screen is a disclosure. Something else (v359) covers any condition without its own pack.
- **Beta until the stores** (v132): clearing `APP_STAGE` in `scripts.js` takes every Beta marker off at once.
- The AI helper is **Daybook Assistant** (v116); the privacy page says plainly that it is Claude, made by Anthropic in the US.
- The App Store category is **Health & Fitness**, not Medical: a journal and report tool for patients and carers to share with their team, never monitoring (Mark, 23 October 2026).
- The data screens stay plain: no pictures behind the cards and charts.
